_unlocked: Protected paths Carl has explicitly authorised for THIS chunk. Overrides 'protected'. Carl's call, not the Builder's. live-work-protocol.md was unlocked on 30 July 2026 so the Builder could record a finding from the guard's own first live use — see the 'First live chunk' note in §8. Authorised by Carl explicitly ('unblock it if you have to, i will go on trust'), not taken by the Builder.
